bio.text: Chuck Grassley has been a U.S. Senator from Iowa since being elected in 1980.
He was first elected to the Iowa state legislature in 1958 and to the U.S. House of Representatives in 1974.
He was born in 1933 in New Hartford, Iowa, farms in Butler County, and studied political science at the University of Northern Iowa (B.A. 1955, M.A. 1956).
